spec.title: ぴよログ 🐣 赤ちゃんダッシュボード
spec.description: 上段は常に直近24時間、体重は全期間、推移と記録は右上の期間で表示します。

panels.title: 前回の授乳から
panels.description: 母乳・ミルク・搾母乳の最新の記録からの経過時間。3時間でオレンジ、4時間で赤。

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(ts)) / 3600.0 AS "前回の授乳から" FROM events WHERE type IN ('BreastFeeding','Formula','ExpressedBreastMilk')

panels.title: 前回のおむつから
panels.description: おしっこ・うんちの最新の記録からの経過時間。

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(ts)) / 3600.0 AS "前回のおむつから" FROM events WHERE type IN ('Pee','Poop')

panels.title: おむつ（24時間）
panels.description: 直近24時間のおしっこ＋うんちの記録数。6回未満で赤になり、アラートが送られます。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "おむつ" FROM events WHERE type IN ('Pee','Poop') AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: 内訳
panels.description: 直近24時間のおしっこ・うんちの回数。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Pee') AS "💧 おしっこ", count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Poop') AS "💩 うんち" FROM events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: 授乳（24時間）
panels.description: 直近24時間の母乳・ミルク・搾母乳の回数。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "授乳" FROM events WHERE type IN ('BreastFeeding','Formula','ExpressedBreastMilk') AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: ミルク量（24時間）
panels.description: 直近24時間のミルク＋搾母乳の合計（母乳の量は含みません）。

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(value_num), 0) AS "ミルク量" FROM events WHERE type IN ('Formula','ExpressedBreastMilk','Drink') AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: 最新の体重
panels.description: いちばん新しい体重の記録（kgの記録はgに換算）。

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT ts, (CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END)::float8 AS g FROM events WHERE type = 'Weight' AND value_num IS NOT NULL) SELECT g AS "体重" FROM w ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

defaults.noValue: まだ記録がありません

panels.title: 出生時から
panels.description: 最初の記録から最新の記録までの増減。

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT ts, (CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END)::float8 AS g FROM events WHERE type = 'Weight' AND value_num IS NOT NULL), f AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1), l AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT l.g - f.g AS "増減" FROM f, l WHERE l.ts > f.ts

defaults.noValue: 測定が2回以上必要です

panels.title: 1日あたり（出生時から）
panels.description: 最初の記録から最新の記録までの1日あたりの平均増加。生まれた直後の体重減少も含みます。

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT ts, (CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END)::float8 AS g FROM events WHERE type = 'Weight' AND value_num IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1), l AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (l.g - b.g) / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM l.ts - b.ts) / 86400.0) AS "1日あたり" FROM b, l WHERE l.ts > b.ts

defaults.noValue: 測定が2回以上必要です

panels.title: 1日あたり（最低体重から）
panels.description: いちばん軽かった記録から最新の記録までの1日あたりの平均増加（生まれた直後の減少後の増え方）。

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT ts, (CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END)::float8 AS g FROM events WHERE type = 'Weight' AND value_num IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY g, ts LIMIT 1), l AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (l.g - b.g) / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM l.ts - b.ts) / 86400.0) AS "1日あたり" FROM b, l WHERE l.ts > b.ts

defaults.noValue: 測定が2回以上必要です

panels.title: 1日あたり（前回の測定から）
panels.description: ひとつ前の記録から最新の記録までの1日あたりの増加。

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT ts, (CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END)::float8 AS g FROM events WHERE type = 'Weight' AND value_num IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY ts DESC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1), l AS (SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (l.g - b.g) / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM l.ts - b.ts) / 86400.0) AS "1日あたり" FROM b, l WHERE l.ts > b.ts

defaults.noValue: 測定が2回以上必要です

panels.title: 体重の推移
panels.description: 体重（g）。期間の選択に関係なく直近30日を表示します。

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT ts, (CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END)::float8 AS g FROM events WHERE type = 'Weight' AND value_num IS NOT NULL) SELECT ts AS time, g AS "体重" FROM w ORDER BY ts

defaults.noValue: まだ記録がありません

panels.title: 測定ごとの増加
panels.description: それぞれの記録とひとつ前の記録との差、および1日あたりの増加。

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT ts, (CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END)::float8 AS g FROM events WHERE type = 'Weight' AND value_num IS NOT NULL), x AS (SELECT ts, g, lag(g) OVER o AS pg, lag(ts) OVER o AS pts FROM w WINDOW o AS (ORDER BY ts)) SELECT ts AS "測定日", g AS "体重", g - pg AS "前回比", (g - pg) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ts - pts) / 86400.0, 0) AS "1日あたり" FROM x ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: 1日のミルク量
panels.description: 日本時間の1日ごとのミルク・搾母乳の量。今日は途中経過です。

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(day, 'MM/DD') AS "日付", sum(value_num) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Formula') AS "🍼 ミルク", sum(value_num) FILTER (WHERE type = 'ExpressedBreastMilk') AS "🍼 搾母乳" FROM (SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date AS day, type, value_num, left_sec, right_sec FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type IN ('Formula','ExpressedBreastMilk')) e GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 1日の母乳時間
panels.description: 日本時間の1日ごとの母乳時間（分）、左右別。

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(day, 'MM/DD') AS "日付", sum(left_sec / 60.0) AS "左", sum(right_sec / 60.0) AS "右" FROM (SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date AS day, type, value_num, left_sec, right_sec FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type IN ('BreastFeeding')) e GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 1日の授乳回数
panels.description: 日本時間の1日ごとの授乳回数、種類別。

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(day, 'MM/DD') AS "日付", sum(1) FILTER (WHERE type = 'BreastFeeding') AS "🤱 母乳", sum(1) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Formula') AS "🍼 ミルク", sum(1) FILTER (WHERE type = 'ExpressedBreastMilk') AS "🍼 搾母乳" FROM (SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date AS day, type, value_num, left_sec, right_sec FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type IN ('BreastFeeding','Formula','ExpressedBreastMilk')) e GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 1日のおむつ
panels.description: 日本時間の1日ごとのおしっこ・うんちの回数。赤い線は6回（アラートの目安）。

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(day, 'MM/DD') AS "日付", sum(1) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Pee') AS "💧 おしっこ", sum(1) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Poop') AS "💩 うんち" FROM (SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date AS day, type, value_num, left_sec, right_sec FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type IN ('Pee','Poop')) e GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: 授乳の最長間隔
panels.description: 1日のうち授乳があいた最長時間（次の授乳があった日に数えます）。

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(day, 'MM/DD') AS "日付", longest_feed_gap_min / 60.0 AS "最長間隔" FROM v_daily WHERE day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date ORDER BY day

panels.title: 記録一覧
panels.description: 選択期間の最新の記録。メモはGrafanaから見えないようにしています。

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "時刻", CASE type WHEN 'BreastFeeding' THEN '🤱 母乳' WHEN 'Formula' THEN '🍼 ミルク' WHEN 'ExpressedBreastMilk' THEN '🍼 搾母乳' WHEN 'Pumping' THEN '搾乳' WHEN 'Pee' THEN '💧 おしっこ' WHEN 'Poop' THEN '💩 うんち' WHEN 'Sleep' THEN '😴 寝る' WHEN 'WakeUp' THEN '🌞 起きる' WHEN 'Weight' THEN '⚖️ 体重' WHEN 'Height' THEN '📏 身長' WHEN 'Bath' THEN '🛁 お風呂' WHEN 'Memo' THEN '📝 メモ' ELSE type END AS "種類", CASE WHEN type = 'BreastFeeding' THEN concat_ws(' / ', '左 ' || round(left_sec / 60) || '分', '右 ' || round(right_sec / 60) || '分') WHEN type = 'Weight' THEN round(CASE WHEN value_unit = 'kg' THEN value_num * 1000 ELSE value_num END) || ' g' WHEN value_num IS NOT NULL THEN value_num::text || ' ' || COALESCE(value_unit, '') WHEN type = 'Poop' THEN concat_ws(' · ', poop_amount, poop_hardness, poop_color) ELSE '' END AS "詳細" FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: 1回ごとのミルク量
panels.description: ミルク・搾母乳の記録ごとの量（ml）。

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, value_num AS "ml", CASE type WHEN 'Formula' THEN '🍼 ミルク' ELSE '🍼 搾母乳' END AS metric FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND type IN ('Formula','ExpressedBreastMilk') AND value_num IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 1日の睡眠時間
panels.description: 日本時間の1日ごとに切り取った睡眠時間。寝る・起きるのペアから計算します。

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(day, 'MM/DD') AS "日付", sleep_hours AS "睡眠" FROM v_daily WHERE sleep_hours IS NOT NULL AND day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date ORDER BY day

defaults.noValue: まだ睡眠の記録がありません 💤

panels.title: 睡眠の記録
panels.description: 寝た→起きたのペア。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sleep_start AS "寝た", sleep_end AS "起きた", hours AS "時間" FROM v_sleep_sessions WHERE sleep_start >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz ORDER BY sleep_start DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: まだ睡眠の記録がありません 💤

panels.title: 最終収集
panels.description: コレクターが最後に動いてからの時間。10分ごとに取得し、30分を超えると赤。

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(ran_at)) / 60.0 AS "最終実行" FROM collector_runs

panels.title: 最終ステータス
panels.description: 最新のコレクター実行の結果。

targets.rawSql: SELECT status AS "状態" FROM collector_runs ORDER BY ran_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: フィードURLの期限
panels.description: ぴよログのフィードURLが切れるまでの日数（FEED_EXPIRES_ON）。

targets.rawSql: SELECT feed_expires_on - (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date AS "残り日数" FROM collector_runs WHERE feed_expires_on IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ran_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 保存済みの記録
panels.description: Postgresに保存されている記録の総数。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "記録数" FROM events
